blocks.text: PaaS cloud mein program banane (development) aur chalane ke liye lagane (deployment) ka poora mahol deta hai. Is mein infrastructure (servers, storage aur networking), middleware (programs ko aapas mein jorne wala software), development tools aur management services sab shamil hain. Developers hardware aur software ki tehon (layers) ko sambhale baghair sirf coding aur applications deploy karne par dhyan dete hain.
Misal (Example): Google App Engine developers ko kai programming languages mein applications banane aur deploy karne deta hai. Doosri misalein Microsoft Azure App Services aur Heroku hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi cloud service aisa platform deti hai jis par customers infrastructure ki fikr ke baghair applications bana, chala aur sambhal sakein (exercise MCQ 8)?

items: PaaS: development aur deployment ka tayyar mahol (infrastructure, middleware, tools).
Developer sirf code par dhyan deta hai (Google App Engine, Azure App Services, Heroku).
